`bun run build` prerenders every page the home links to, directly or not, to
`dist/client`, with a `sitemap.xml` and a `404.html`. Nothing runs on the
server: the Worker serves files.

## Deploy

```sh
bun run build
bunx wrangler deploy
```

`wrangler.jsonc` names the Worker. Uncomment its `routes` to serve the site
on your own domain.

## Check before you ship

```sh
bun run check-types
bun run test
```

The test reads every page: a dead link, a page the sidebar forgets or a page
nothing links to fails it.
